name: elenchus
description: Elenchus: multiplayer LLM workspace. Stop copy-pasting AI replies. One thread — your team, your AI, everyone in the same room, each using your own LLM API key or custom model. Think "Claude Team" without the hassle.

paragraphs: Multiplayer AI workspace. Multiple people share one conversation thread, each bringing their own API key. @mention Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT — or your own self-hosted model. Whoever you tag responds, billed to the person who called them.
Live demo — hosted on Supabase free tier, so new account creation may be rate-limited.
features: Multiplayer conversations — shared thread, real-time sync, messages attributed to each person
BYOK per user — each member adds their own API key; you never pay for anyone else
Multi-provider — Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), OpenAI (ChatGPT); or Custom endpoint: each user picks their own
Bring your own model — point your account at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, MLX, LM Studio, vLLM, Groq…), name it, and @mention it like any other provider
Vision + documents — attach images and PDFs; images sent as vision inputs, PDFs extracted or sent natively to Claude

whatItDoes.text: Multiplayer AI workspace. Multiple people share one conversation thread, each bringing their own API key. @mention Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT — or your own self-hosted model. Whoever you tag responds, billed to the person who called them.

requirements.text: Multiple people share one conversation thread, each bringing their own API key. @mention Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT — or your own self-hosted model.
In Settings → AI Provider → Custom you set an agent name (which becomes the @mention handle), the endpoint's base URL, the model name, and an optional API key.
